denominators.note: count shares divide by targets, byte shares divide by billed bytes, per-episode values divide by seeds; the three must never be mixed in one sentence

auc_provenance.confound: the outcome attributed to a dropped report is that arm's recorded outcome; A2's robots moved differently because they were not told, so the bookkeeping is not a per-message counterfactual
auc_provenance.data_split: NONE. The same 60 seeds produced the labels, the AUC and the threshold; there is no held-out part and no cross-validation
auc_provenance.features_source: reconstructed from the A1 transcript's first-report records and the A1 lifecycle detection records; not read from a decision tape (no deployed cell in the archive has one)
auc_provenance.label: the three descriptive buckets above, built from the A1/A2 whole-policy contrast on seeds 1100000..1100059
auc_provenance.model_fitted: none — a rank statistic (Mann-Whitney U / AUC) and an exhaustive threshold sweep
auc_provenance.status: development-set exploratory result. It is not a validated effect size and must not be cited as one; seeds 1100000..1100059 are 'seen' under PROJECT_CHARTER.md §10 and cannot serve as an unseen test set
auc_provenance.threshold_selection: every distinct feature value swept in both directions, scored by counterfactual bookkeeping, cheapest rule at full recorded effect reported
auc_provenance.why_those_nine_are_constant_or_unused_he: all 352 archived emissions are first reports (revision == 1, members empty), so the change-detection dims have no previous view to compare against; queue_backlog_targets was not reconstructed and is assumed small under `immediate` but was NOT verified per cell
